independent_method: exact rational Gaussian elimination, separate from modular certificate

modular.proof: All states reached after k outputs; positive prefix weights. Conditional length-k matrix is an invertible row-scaled Hankel submatrix when determinant mod p is nonzero. A fixed D-dimensional instrument has probability rank at most D^2.
modular.limitation: rank mod p below D is only a lower bound, not proof of rank deficiency
